title: Generation of gene-of-interest double allele knockout clones in primary human T cells by CRISPR
protocol: Obtain human blood samples from volunteers or blood bank.
Separate human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from the blood sample.
Pre-warm density gradient medium (Ficcoll) to room temperature around 25°C before use.
Transfer blood sample to a 50 mL Falcon tube and dilute 1:2 with PBS.
Add Ficoll to another Falcon tube.
Pipette the diluted blood sample down along the side of the tube gently.
Spin at 1,200 × g for 20 min, accelerate 7, brake off, at room temperature around 25°C.
Collect the mononucleated cells at the interface between the gradient medium and upper supernatant.
Wash enriched cells by topping up with PBS.
Spin at 300 × g for 10 min, normal speed, 4°C.
Wash the pellet again as in step h.
Count the cell number.
Store the rest of the cells in Freezing medium (90% FBS + 10% DMSO) for future use.
Apply negative selection kits for T cell isolation from Miltenyi Biotec or STEMCELL.
Count the number of T cells after isolation.
Store remaining cells in freezing medium for future use.
Prepare anti-CD3/CD28 Dynabeads or suitable alternative for T cell activation.
Draw amount of bead solution according to the cell number required for activation and add equal volume of buffer (PBS with 0.1% BSA, 2 mM EDTA, pH 7.5), mix thoroughly.
Place tube on a magnet for 1 min; discard supernatant.
Resuspend washed beads in an equal volume of culture medium as the initial bead volume.
Mix washed beads and T cells evenly at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 T cells/mL.
Supplement with human IL-2 at 100 U/mL.
Activate T cells with beads in a 37°C incubator for 60 hours.
Add 1 mL of T cell culture medium to one well of a 12-well plate and incubate at 37°C to pre-warm the medium.
Perform PCR on the HDR donor DNA fragment containing LHA-selection gene marker-RHA from HDR template plasmid.
Mix crRNA and tracrRNA and run duplex cooling program according to materials and equipment instructions.
Add Cas9 protein to the duplexed gRNA and incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge the 1 × 10^6 T cells at 90 × g for 10 minutes at room temperature around 25°C.
Resuspend the T cell pellet carefully in 100 μL of Nucleofector® Solution.
Mix RNP solutions with the 2 μg donor DNA fragment for at least 30 seconds.
Combine 100 μL of cell suspension with RNP-DNA mixture, transfer into a cuvette.
Add 500 μL of pre-equilibrated culture medium from the prepared 12 well plate to the cuvette.
Gently add the cell sample back to the well dropwise.
Incubate in the 37°C incubator for 15 min.
Add IL-2 (500 U/mL) to each well and culture until confluent in the 12-well plate.
Sort the double selection gene marker-expressing cells by staining with fluorescent antibodies and analyzing with a fluorescence flow cytometer.
Culture the sorted cells in medium supplemented with IL-2 (500 U/mL).
Restimulate and expand the sorted T cells when proliferation stops or slows down using irradiated PBMCs as feeder cells.
Irradiate PBMCs with 30 Gy.
Mix irradiated PBMCs with sorted T cells at a ratio of 3:1.
Add PBMCs according to the surface area if the sorted cell number is fewer than 1 × 10^6 cells.
Add 3 × 10^6 irradiated PBMCs to one well of a 6-well plate and 1 × 10^6 to one well of a 12-well plate.
For strict FACS clone selection with fewer than 20 cells per well in a 96-well plate, add 2 × 10^5 irradiated PBMCs per well.
Supplement the medium with 100 U/mL IL-2, 10 ng/mL IL-7, and 10 ng/mL IL-15, and 1.5 μg/mL PHA lectin.
Designate this day as day 0.
Check T cell clusters on day 5; passage expanded T cells to maintain a density of 1–3 × 10^6/mL.
Check the expression of selection gene markers.
Select cells expressing both markers.
Validate GOI knockout using primers for PCR and western blotting.
Culture and expand the cells until they arrest proliferation.
Freeze and aliquot the cells in freezing medium (90% FBS, 10% DMSO).
